heroHeadline: China Claims Expanded Zone Around Scarborough Shoal as Manila Protests Blocked Resupply
heroSubtitle: After Chinese ships blocked a Philippine resupply mission to Second Thomas Shoal, Beijing drilled boarding and drone operations at Scarborough Shoal and state media claimed control of features beyond 24 nautical miles. Malaysia is separately bolstering Sabah defenses.
